model_evaluation: argmax, no action assistance or model-error fallback
clock: 400 joint-action ticks; inference does not advance simulation
selection: Choose at most one training candidate using only train demonstrations and an internal train-episode validation split. Compare candidate and incumbent on the two fixed validation tasks; accept only more paired wins than losses. Run heldout once after selection, without further tuning.
limits: Small deterministic pilot, one episode per condition; not a statistically powered generalization benchmark. Stationary streaks include legitimate cooking waits.
